title: Bug:frrcfgd does not have support for BGP_MONITORS config
author: selva-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

When we do BGP_MONITORS table entries configured with frr_mgmt_framework_config = 'true' and docker_routing_config_mode = 'unified', it does not take effect in FRR.

The frrcfgd does not have support for BGP_MONITORS table configuration.  We have the yang model available sonic-bgp-monitor.yang but there is no implementation available in frrcfgd.

Affected BGP testcases:
- sonic-mgmt/testcases/bgp/test_bgp_mon.py
- sonic-mgmt/testcases/bgp/test_bgp_allow_list.py
- sonic-mgmt/testcases/bgp/test_traffic_shift.py



### Steps to Reproduce

Configure BGP_MONITORS feature, using sonic-bgp-monitor.yang schema. 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior:
There is no configuration applied in FRR

Expected Behavior:
The BgpMonitor neighrbors should be configured with appropriate peer-gorup and policy in FRR.

Following hardcoded stuffs are not allowed in frrcfgd, you have to use the CONFIG_DB BGP tables for all configurations explicitly, if not present, define the new tables/fields as necessary. The idea of frrcfgd itself is to have all configs knobs exposed to the user without any implicit assumptions internally.


            self.bgp_peer_group[vrf]['BGPMON'] = BGPPeerGroup(vrf)

                "vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c '{}' -c 'address-family ipv4' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON activate' -c 'neighbor BGPMON route-map FROM_BGPMON in' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON route-map TO_BGPMON out' -c 'neighbor BGPMON send-community' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON maximum-prefix 1' -c 'exit-address-family'".format(router_bgp_cmd)
            ]
            ipv6_commands = [
                "vtysh -c 'configure terminal' -c '{}' -c 'address-family ipv6' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON activate' -c 'neighbor BGPMON route-map FROM_BGPMON in' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON route-map TO_BGPMON out' -c 'neighbor BGPMON send-community' "
                "-c 'neighbor BGPMON maximum-prefix 1' -c 'exit-address-family'".format(router_bgp_cmd)
            ]
            for cmd in ipv4_commands + ipv6_commands:
                if not self.__run_command(table, cmd):
                    syslog.syslog(syslog.LOG_ERR, 'failed to configure BGPMON peer-group address families')
                    return False
